description.value: Truffle Pigs Bistro & Lodge is a 12-room mountain lodge in Field, British Columbia, situated in the heart of Yoho National Park just 20 minutes west of Lake Louise. Founded in 2000 as a café and general store, it expanded into its current lodge-and-bistro format in 2008 and has built a reputation for passionate, creative cooking alongside warm Rocky Mountain hospitality. Touring cyclists will find hearty on-site meals and rooms with sweeping views of the surrounding peaks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and richly detailed. The lodge page explicitly lists 'Free WiFi' as a standard feature in all 12 rooms, confirming the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. The on-site Truffle Pigs Bistro is confirmed open daily for dinner, providing nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, tools, or any other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Truffle Pigs Lodge' but the business operates as 'Truffle Pigs Bistro & Lodge' per the website.
Minor address spelling discrepancy: OSM lists 'Centre Street' while the website uses 'Center Street' (American spelling variant).
Phone number 250.343.6303 is present on the website but absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible lodge in Yoho National Park with active website, current menus, and online booking available.
enrichment_extras.notes: The FAQ notes that lunch kits can be prepared for hikers and adventurers upon check-in, which may be of interest to touring cyclists. Breakfast is mentioned as seasonally available (not after October 14th) but no early or packed breakfast option is explicitly described.

Nearby evening food.detail: Truffle Pigs Bistro is on-site in the same building, serving dinner daily from 5 pm until 8:45 pm with bar open until 10 pm
